meta.concept:
Neon Fugitive functions as a fully 3D third-person open-world experience targeting PC platforms with driving as the primary mode of traversal. The core player mechanics prioritize high-speed vehicle handling on hoverbikes across six distinct districts, supported by a Cinemachine camera system that utilizes lock-on targeting and dynamic tracking during pursuits. While foot-based parkour systems for wall-running and vaulting are integrated into specific extraction or stealth sequences within the urban fabric, the gameplay loop centers on vehicular momentum to navigate rain-soaked corridors, industrial docks, and skyways. The input architecture manages complex steering and throttle mechanics essential for evasion and combat maneuvers, ensuring the driving experience remains the dominant interaction model without contradicting the primary movement shape defined by the project constraints.

The technical stack requires a robust suite of systems including custom vehicle physics controllers, enemy AI utilizing NavMesh components for patrol and chase states, and an audio mixer layering eight distinct looping tracks with non-looping sound effects. Key architectural features include a bounty contract manager to track live objectives, a health and shield damage system, dialogue hologram triggers for the eight narrative acts, and a save-load checkpoint service tied to act progression. The world generation relies on procedural geometry tools for runtime terrain and road networks in the outer slums, while ProBuilder handles static construction for underground tunnels. The visual pipeline utilizes URP with heavy post-processing configurations for bloom and chromatic aberration against the specific NeonFugitive color palette of deep violet backgrounds and cyan accents to maintain the stylized cyberpunk aesthetic throughout day-night lighting cycles.

Development must be executed on Unity version 6000.0 LTS to ensure stability and performance optimization for the open-world architecture. The toolchain leverages standard integrated components such as NavMesh Agent for AI pathfinding, Input System for unified control scheme management across driving and pedestrian states, and Cinemachine for cinematic camera transitions between vehicle and foot movement. No networking or multiplayer systems are required; focus remains entirely on single-player physics interactions, environmental destruction within the open world, and atmospheric lighting cycles that shift dynamically per district. All content instances—including enemy AI, vehicle models, and scene objects—must align with the defined narrative beats and visual identity without introducing unrequested entities into the build pipeline.
meta.user_prompt:
Neon Fugitive — a third-person open-world cyberpunk bounty-hunter game for PC.

The player is a rogue AI enforcement agent navigating six districts of a rain-soaked
megacity at night. Each district has its own visual identity: neon markets, industrial
docks, corporate towers, underground tunnels, a rooftop skyway, and the flooded
outer slums. All six districts plus a main menu, a boss arena, and a credits scene
must be separate Unity scenes.

NARRATIVE — eight acts of escalating story beats:
1. Activation: player boots up for the first time in an alley (on_start)
2. First Mark: player receives the first bounty contract (on_enter_zone)
3. Street Chase: player pursues mark through market crowds (on_enemy_death)
4. Betrayal: handler reveals the player is also a target (on_timer)
5. Underground: player escapes into the tunnel district (on_enter_zone)
6. Data Heist: player steals identity files from corporate tower (on_pickup)
7. Showdown: final confrontation with the original programmer (manual)
8. Escape: player reaches the sky-bridge extraction point (on_enter_zone)

AUDIO — rich layered soundscape across eight tracks:
- Pulsing synth main theme (looping music, plays on menu)
- District market ambient (looping ambient, tense urban crowd)
- Industrial dock drone (looping ambient, machinery hum and water)
- Chase adrenaline track (looping music, fast-paced synth percussion)
- Corporate tower tension (looping music, slow arpeggiated suspense)
- Rain and thunder environment (looping ambient, outdoor weather)
- Combat hit and gunshot SFX pack (non-looping sfx, action punctuation)
- Victory sting and credits outro (non-looping music, emotional resolution)

PROCEDURAL GEOMETRY — runtime-built world pieces:
- Procedural terrain for the outer slum district (terrain type, resolution 64)
- Procedural road network grid for market district (road type, resolution 48)
- Procedural water plane for the flooded outer zone (water type, resolution 32)
- Procedural room layout for the corporate tower interior (room type, resolution 24)

SYSTEMS — everything this game needs:
- Third-person player movement with parkour (wall-run, vault, slide)
- Cinemachine third-person camera with lock-on targeting mode
- Enemy AI with NavMesh patrol, chase, and alert states
- Bounty system tracking multiple live contracts simultaneously
- Health and damage system with shields and healing pickups
- Dialogue manager playing all eight story beats as in-world hologram events
- District manager switching ambient audio and sky color per zone transition
- Day-night cycle controller driving scene lighting and NPC schedules
- Vehicle controller for rideable hoverbikes in open sections
- Weapon system managing ranged and melee attack combos
- Inventory and equipment screen
- Minimap radar displaying bounty targets and district boundaries
- Save and checkpoint system between acts
- ProBuilder level generator producing the tunnel and rooftop districts at edit time

VISUAL STYLE: stylized — heavy neon on deep dark backgrounds.
COLOR PALETTE name "NeonFugitive":
  primary   #00F5FF  (player energy — cyan glow)
  secondary #1A0A2E  (environment base — near-black violet)
  accent    #FF2D78  (enemies and hazards — hot pink)
  background #0D0D1A (sky and voids — pitch dark blue)
  trim      #FFD600  (UI, collectibles, highlights — electric yellow)

RENDER PIPELINE: URP (post-processing bloom and chromatic aberration essential).
UNITY VERSION: 6000.0
PLATFORM: PC

audio_cues.gen_prompt: High-pitched electric whine mixed with wet rubber squeal on slick rain-slicked asphalt.
Deep, resonant ion hum vibrating through the chassis as throttle pushes against atmospheric drag.
Rhythmic drumming of heavy neon-lit raindrops hitting metal grates and puddles in industrial docks.
Sharp, staccato impact thuds as magnetic soles snap against wet concrete during parkour sequences.
Soft, crackling static interference layered beneath a clear synthetic voice projecting from the air.
Low-frequency rumble of shifting procedural geometry and unstable road networks under heavy vehicle weight.
Muffled, echoing drip sounds and distant water flow resonating within ProBuilder constructed subterranean spaces.
Mechanical servos whirring and hydraulic pistons hissing as drones calculate pursuit vectors through rain.
Subtle, high-frequency digital chime signaling objective updates within the deep violet interface overlay.
Whooshing gusts of cold air rushing past open cockpit as hoverbike navigates elevated urban corridors.
